title: Concept: Dependency fetched over cleartext HTTP
description: package.json declares a dependency URL that uses cleartext `http://`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Cleartext transport lets a network attacker replace the artifact in flight, and the substitution is invisible after the install succeeds.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Cleartext transport lets a network attacker replace the artifact in flight, and the substitution is invisible after the install succeeds.
